_doc: Per-hymn patches applied by build_hymnal.dart. Keys are hymn ids. Supported: title, author, meter, tuneName (replace); verses: {index: [lines]} (replace one verse); chorus: [lines]; replaceText: [[find, replace]] (applied to each verse/chorus joined with \n so it can split or merge lines; empty lines dropped); notes: [text]; optionalVerses / alternateChoruses: [{label, lines}]; copyright; rightsStatus. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

41.title: Come, ye that know the Saviour's name

0: Who bowed His head and died;
Who hath redeemed us by His blood;
He comes to take us home to God.

120.author: Nikolaus Ludwig von Zinzendorf, tr. John Wesley
notes: Alternate first line: God's Christ, who is my righteousness

chorus: Trim your lamps and be ready,
Trim your lamps and be ready,
Trim your lamps and be ready
Trim your lamps and be ready,
notes: The full chorus is sung to the tune “Trim your Lamps”.
With the tune Yarmouth, the third line of each verse is sung twice.

replaceText:
Lost ones found and
Dead ones raised,
Lost ones found and dead ones raised,
321.author: Richard Chenevix Trench

replaceText:
Its breadth, depth, height, and
everlasting strength!
Its breadth, depth, height, and everlasting strength!

notes: With the tune Helmsley, the fifth line of each verse is sung three times.
Verse 3 may also be sung as a chorus.

_unclear: 20th-century texts whose rights must be confirmed with the publisher before release. Marked unclear so the build report lists them; the app does not show this status to readers.
